name: Korean peninsula
summary: No North Korean launch found since 4 Nov, when it tested a new air defence system; two-week window closes 18 Nov
state: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff detected multiple missiles fired from South Hamgyong towards the East Sea on 4 Nov, flying under 300km; Pyongyang said it tested a new air defence missile system (Korea Herald, 5 Nov). Searches to 18 Nov found no further launch, nuclear test or border clash. The 4 Nov launch falls at the edge of the rubric's two-week window, so Watch is kept for now (hysteresis).
for_you: There is no direct risk to UK residents. Travellers to South Korea or Japan should follow FCDO travel advice and local alerts.
